assistant_text: 我先检查记忆服务进程、健康状态和最近日志，确认是服务停止、端口变化，还是数据库/网络问题。 目前看不是 Tailscale：记忆服务的后台任务仍在运行，但它刚经历了一次重启循环。直接原因是 Neo4j 在 10:43 左右被停止，记忆服务连续连不上 `127.0.0.1:7687`，随后被系统重新拉起。现在我把依赖和主服务按正确顺序重新拉起并复核。

tools.name: exec
tools.summary: echo '--- health ---'; curl -sS -m 3 -i http://127.0.0.1:8787/healthz 2>&1 || true; echo '--- port ---'; lsof -nP -iTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>&1 || true; echo '--- logs ---'; find /Users/seancao/memd/logs -type f -maxdepth 2 -print 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -10; for f in /Users/seancao/memd/logs/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "### $f"; tail -30 "$f"; }; done (exit 0)

tools.name: exec
tools.summary: sleep 1; curl -sS -m 5 -i http://127.0.0.1:8787/healthz 2>&1 || true; echo; curl -sS -m 5 -i http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health 2>&1 || true; echo; tail -80 /Users/seancao/memd/logs/memd.err (exit 0)

tools.name: exec
tools.summary: echo '--- recent log tail ---'; tail -25 /Users/seancao/memd/logs/memd.err; echo '--- launch agents ---'; launchctl list 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'agentmemory|memd|neo4j' || true; find /Users/seancao/Library/LaunchAgents /Library/LaunchDaemons -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | rg -i 'mem|agent' || true (exit 0)

tools.name: exec
tools.summary: plutil -p /Users/seancao/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agentmemory.memd.plist 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.agentmemory.memd 2>&1 | head -80 (exit 0)

tools.name: exec
tools.summary: lsof -nP -iTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN; date; curl -v --noproxy '*' -m 2 http://localhost:8787/ 2>&1 | tail -20; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.agentmemory.memd 2>/dev/null | rg 'pid =|last terminating|runs =' (exit 0)
